categories.title: Zines / Artist Books
categories.success_condition: Two finished zines, five outreach attempts, one accepted placement.
categories.why_this_path: The zine path is currently the fastest route to public visibility. There are 12 identified targets, including 7 in Koenji/Nakano. Costs are relatively low, and one printed project can be reused for shop placement, applications, sales, fairs, portfolio proof, and later publishing outreach.

categories.title: Publishing
categories.success_condition: One strong PDF pitch, five suitable publishers, two careful outreach attempts.
categories.why_this_path: Publishing is a strong secondary path after a zine or artist-book object exists. It is low-cost but slower and more relationship-dependent.

categories.title: Galleries
categories.success_condition: One coherent portfolio PDF, one statement, and targeted applications to best-fit spaces.
categories.why_this_path: Galleries matter, but they are slower and more selective. They become stronger after real-world proof from zines, shops, or small fairs.

categories.title: Cafés / Shops
categories.success_condition: A small wall-ready set or print display and five local outreach attempts.
categories.why_this_path: Cafés and shops can be useful for local visibility, but the current priority is stronger through zine/book targets.

categories.title: Licensing
categories.success_condition: A clean sample sheet, contact list, and one focused licensing vertical.
categories.why_this_path: Licensing could matter later for book covers, stationery, magazines, or album art, but the current database is not built out yet.
